# Preview release delivery

The reviewed pipeline prepares a draft prerelease for an existing
`vX.Y.Z-preview.N` tag whose version exactly matches Cargo.toml. It does not bump
versions, push commits, publish an APT repository, sign credentials or publish the
draft automatically. No new release is implied by this documentation.

Remote locked tests/builds produce Linux x86-64 and Windows x86-64 binaries.
Linux uses Ubuntu 22.04 (glibc 2.35 or newer); the initial user-local WSL installation target is Ubuntu
24.04 x86-64. macOS/ARM delivery is not verified or supplied by this pipeline.
Each asset is named `proj_<version>_<os>_<arch>[.exe]`, with matching `version.txt`
and `checksums.txt`. Exact-tag help/version/protocol smokes and actual installer
tests must pass before assets enter the draft. Checksums detect corruption and
mismatches; they are not independent signatures or reproducible-build attestations.

Installers default to MiguelRodo/projcli, require version metadata and exactly one
matching SHA256 entry, and verify downloaded bytes before replacement. They stage
on the installation filesystem and need only an existing user-writable directory.
`PROJ_RELEASE_VERSION` pins a release (with optional `v`); preview releases should
always be pinned because GitHub's latest URL normally selects stable releases.
`PROJ_INSTALL_DIR` selects an existing absolute user directory without changing
PATH or system settings. Existing older releases lacking the new metadata fail
closed instead of installing an unverified fallback binary.

Before publication: reconcile reviewed supported behavior and limits, update the
Cargo/Cargo.lock preview version in a reviewed change, verify required checks,
then create the exact reviewed tag. Inspect the resulting draft assets/version/
checksums and retain disposable-project warnings. Publish only after those checks.
For WSL, download the pinned binary/manifest, verify SHA256, preserve any existing
user-local binary, install into the chosen user-local directory and smoke help,
version, capabilities and a disposable configured preview. No local compilation,
sudo, persistent authentication change or R package modification is needed.

Known limits include bounded captured-state recovery, arbitrary external script
effects, incomplete direct R/IDE parity, incomplete attempt/release records and
analysis-free publication retry. This is a development preview, not M2 completion.

The prepared CLI package version is `0.4.0-preview.1`; its review and the final
integrated main checks precede creating tag `v0.4.0-preview.1`. Cargo.toml and the
root proj entry in Cargo.lock match. `proj --version` and machine `cli_version`
report that package version. `proj version get` reads an analysis project VERSION
and is deliberately a separate value; existing project VERSION files are not bumped
by preparing the CLI release.
The [feature status](preview-status.qmd) distinguishes implemented Rust behavior,
pending recovery verification, R/IDE gaps and unfinished M2 records/provenance/retry.
No broad milestone checkbox is closed merely to enable binary delivery.

## Verified delivery

[0.4.0-preview.1](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/releases/tag/v0.4.0-preview.1) is published as a prerelease; stable Latest remains
v0.3.0. Its [tag workflow](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/39515169842) passed, and both uploaded binaries were
downloaded, hash-checked and executed for help/version/capabilities. Public downloads
matched the verified asset bytes. Source identity is
`bbd12edc8de9865a96b6145d0c7702f1300cb1a8`; package version is 0.4.0-preview.1,
protocol version 1. The WSL user-local install and disposable Python success/failure
smokes passed without local compilation. See [compatibility evidence](compatibility.qmd).

Pin `PROJ_RELEASE_VERSION=0.4.0-preview.1` when using the installer from that tag.
Use an existing absolute user-local `PROJ_INSTALL_DIR`; installation changes no
system/PATH settings. macOS/ARM artifacts remain unavailable. Keep the disposable-
project limits and unfinished R/IDE/M2 scope from [feature status](preview-status.qmd).

## Next preview preparation

The [next-preview checklist](release-candidate.qmd) records source integration,
actual acceptance, reviewed version changes, exact-tag assets and WSL replacement.
The published/installed preview remains 0.4.0-preview.1 until those steps complete.
No new tag, release or installation is announced here. Bookdown site embedding
remains native; other deferred limits stay explicit.

Public README/install pins and public-download check expectations stay at the
existing preview through tagging, draft validation, publication and public-byte
verification. Update them together in a separate post-publication docs change:
those CI checks fetch the public version and source-commit assets and cannot
validate an unpublished pin. Release notes/version metadata can be prepared earlier.
